title.zh: 【穆迪给予 Sky Protocol B3 评级，为其首个获评稳定币协议】
title.en: 【穆迪给予 Sky Protocol B3 评级，为其首个获评稳定币协议】

current_state.zh: Moody's assigned Sky Protocol (formerly MakerDAO) a first-of-its-kind B3 stable-outlook credit rating for a stablecoin protocol, with S&P separately rating it B-, making Sky the only stablecoin protocol with formal ratings from both agencies.
current_state.en: Moody's assigned Sky Protocol (formerly MakerDAO) a first-of-its-kind B3 stable-outlook credit rating for a stablecoin protocol, with S&P separately rating it B-, making Sky the only stablecoin protocol with formal ratings from both agencies.
